attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kansas corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false /result.ks_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions)

action_details.action_postfix: true /result.ks_has_nexus xdef "Kansas filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)" job.audit_trail swap addto
true /result.ks_has_nexus xdef "Kansas filing required: Economic nexus (exceeds $100,000 gross receipts or 200 transactions)" job.audit_trail swap addto
false /result.ks_has_nexus xdef 0.0 /result.ks_tax_liability xdef "Kansas filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KS requires addback of federal interest income and state income tax refunds, with subtraction of Kansas municipal bond interest.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ks_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.ks_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ks_state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.ks_state_subtractions xdef "Kansas adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas corporate income tax. Applies Kansas two-tier rate (4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ks_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ks_base_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ks_surtax xdef 0.0 /result.ks_tax_liability xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax with base rate + surtax (income over $50K)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.ks_apportioned_income result.ks_state_additions add result.ks_state_subtractions sub 0.0 max /result.ks_taxable_income xdef
result.ks_taxable_income result.ks_corp_tax_base_rate mul /result.ks_base_tax xdef
result.ks_taxable_income result.ks_surtax_threshold sub result.ks_corp_tax_surtax_rate mul /result.ks_surtax xdef
result.ks_base_tax result.ks_surtax add /ks_tax_before_credits xdef
ks_tax_before_credits result.ks_state_credits sub 0.0 max /result.ks_tax_liability xdef
result.ks_estimated_payments result.ks_tax_liability sub /result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef
"Kansas taxable income: $" result.ks_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas base tax (4.0%): $" result.ks_base_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas surtax (3.0% on excess over $50K): $" result.ks_surtax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas tax liability: $" result.ks_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax - income $50K or less (base rate only)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.ks_apportioned_income result.ks_state_additions add result.ks_state_subtractions sub 0.0 max /result.ks_taxable_income xdef
result.ks_taxable_income result.ks_corp_tax_base_rate mul /result.ks_base_tax xdef
0.0 /result.ks_surtax xdef
result.ks_base_tax result.ks_state_credits sub 0.0 max /result.ks_tax_liability xdef
result.ks_estimated_payments result.ks_tax_liability sub /result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef
"Kansas taxable income: $" result.ks_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas tax liability (4.0%): $" result.ks_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ks_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ks_tax_liability xdef result.ks_estimated_payments /result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ks_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ks_tax_liability xdef result.ks_estimated_payments /result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
